name: Usury Or Interest
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes the practice of charging interest, permitting it only when lending to strangers while forbidding it among brethren, especially those in poverty. Passages such as Exodus 22:25 and Leviticus 25:35-37 emphasize compassion and the prohibition of usury to preserve the well-being of fellow Israelites. Deuteronomy 23:19-20 reinforces this by allowing interest from strangers but commanding mercy and restraint within the community, highlighting God's desire for His people to live in mutual support and blessing.
